name: Android TV 4K
description: Optimized for 4K Android TV devices (Google TV Streamer, Shield). GPU rendering, hardware decode, AC3/DTS passthrough.
mpv_conf:
vo=gpu
gpu-context=android
hwdec=mediacodec
dither-depth=auto
audio-spdif=ac3,dts
volume-max=100
volume=100
demuxer-max-bytes=150MiB
demuxer-readahead-secs=120
osd-font-size=40
osd-duration=2000
screenshot-format=jpg
screenshot-jpeg-quality=95
save-position-on-quit=yes
input_conf:
RIGHT seek 10
LEFT seek -10
FORWARD no-osd seek 30
REWIND no-osd seek -30
1 add audio-delay +0.1
4 add audio-delay -0.1
7 set audio-delay 0; show-text "Audio delay: 0ms" 2000
0 set video-zoom 0; no-osd set panscan 0; no-osd set video-pan-x 0; no-osd set video-pan-y 0; no-osd set video-align-x 0; no-osd set video-align-y 0; show-text "Zoom/Pan reset" 1500
3 cycle-values video-aspect-override 16:9 4:3 2.35:1 no
2 add panscan 0.01
5 add panscan -0.01
8 set panscan 0.42
6 screenshot; show-text "Screenshot saved" 2000
BS show-text "${media-title}\n${width}x${height} ${video-codec}" 5000
PLAYPAUSE cycle pause
PLAY set pause no
PAUSE set pause yes

name: Android TV 1080p
description: For 1080p Android TV boxes with weaker hardware. Conservative settings, smaller buffers.
mpv_conf:
vo=gpu
gpu-context=android
hwdec=mediacodec
dither-depth=auto
audio-spdif=ac3
volume-max=100
volume=100
demuxer-max-bytes=64MiB
demuxer-readahead-secs=60
osd-font-size=36
osd-duration=2000
screenshot-format=jpg
save-position-on-quit=yes
input_conf:
RIGHT seek 10
LEFT seek -10
PLAYPAUSE cycle pause
6 screenshot
BS show-text "${media-title}" 3000

name: Low Latency Live
description: For live stream playback (TikTok, RTMP, HLS). Minimal buffering, fast start.
mpv_conf:
vo=gpu
gpu-context=android
hwdec=mediacodec
profile=low-latency
audio-spdif=ac3
volume-max=100
volume=100
osd-font-size=40
osd-duration=2000
input_conf:
RIGHT seek 5
LEFT seek -5
PLAYPAUSE cycle pause

name: Minimal
description: Bare minimum config. Hardware decode, no extras. Good starting point for custom configs.
input_conf:
RIGHT seek 10
LEFT seek -10
PLAYPAUSE cycle pause
